title: Logo ending over landscape

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Integrate identification into the moving scene so the brand arrives as part of the experience rather than an unrelated interruption.
strategic_value: A ring reveal that retains the landscape can connect Audi recognition with travel imagery.
demonstration: The 7.08-second clip begins with landscape footage, reveals dark then white rings, changes aerial view and resolves to Audi Vorsprung durch Technik as the background fades to black.
practical_value: Compare the ring reveal with the later text sign-off and preserve their distinct jobs.

content_islands.name: Landscape opening
content_islands.spec: Fill the frame with a road beside reflective water.

content_islands.name: Ring reveal
content_islands.spec: Reveal the rings across the center, resolve them to white and carry them into another landscape view.

content_islands.name: Text ending
content_islands.spec: Replace the rings with the small red Audi and white slogan lockup as the landscape darkens.

reference_purposes.Expression: The rings resolve within moving landscape footage before a text sign-off.
reference_purposes.Application: The source presents this as a logo-ending example.
reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent Smart tools section explains that the logo-ending app makes the animated logo part of the brand message.

ingredient.name: Animated ring ending
ingredient.role: Connect the moving scene to Audi identification.
ingredient.application: Observe the ring reveal followed by a separate text sign-off. Use the source as a sequence example, not a universal timing specification.
ingredient.scope: One 7.08-second KMS case-study clip; no required duration or placement for every Audi film is stated.
